CheckTitle: Ensure SoD Across Fusion and OCI Is Monitored
Benchmark: CIS Oracle SaaS Cloud Applications Benchmark v1.0.0
SubSectionName: Application Business User Separation of Duties (SoD)
RequiredAccess: Fusion Applications Security Console / Audit Reports (IT Security Manager)
OCI tenancy access (IAM policies, Fusion environment settings, Logging, Monitoring)
Fusion Cloud Applications Risk Management (Advanced Controls)
Description: Users holding conflicting combinations across Fusion and OCI (for example OCI service administrator and Fusion security administrator) should be monitored.
Risk: Combined infrastructure and application privileges allow changes that bypass both sets of controls.
AuditProcedure: Identify users with conflicting combinations across Fusion and OCI.
Automated alternative: deploy the matching Transaction/Access Controls in Fusion Cloud Applications Risk Management so changes start an investigation workflow. Examples: 4651-4654.

Steps: Remove unwanted assignments or monitor the users' transactions.
Review the affected transactions in Tools > Reports and Analytics, or monitor them continuously with Risk Management Transaction Controls.
